preview_lines: *,"Welcome Explorer! I'm Chloe, your Aira AI assistant. I have three tips to share with you to help you get started. The screen on the phone you're holding is disabled to create a voice first experience. To talk to me, you can hold down on the call button located below the screen, and say things like, ""how do I use Horizon?"" or ""what can you do?"" Would you like me to repeat that or continue?",Tutorial Start,Tutorial Setup

* continue|next *,"To call an agent, make sure that you've used the braided tether cord to connect the Horizon glasses to the Horizon phone.
